interpretation.complete_code_binding: Numeric Durbin9108B and Gram-Schmidt24372B are byte-identical to the frozen candidate Objects. Callers15636B/41508B differ only in decoded BL relocation fields that resolve to captured numeric functions in the same sampled PID; every other byte matches. Both processes terminate0 with finite C outputs/exact counters.

gramschmidt_finite_classification.mechanism: Five actual mov.d sites take scalar decisions after per-value SIMD mask reductions: source matrix read, invariant column read, projection read, multiply and subtract. Each has and/cmeq/umaxp/mov/cbnz control between original arithmetic operations. These sites prove the added work executes; their sampled share is not its exclusive total cost.

gramschmidt_publication.mechanism: Selected-publication header and scalar copy store remain prominent. Rejected55 selected row-span publication is not retried.

durbin_finite_classification.mechanism: Scalar source/read, captured-factor and intermediate classification instructions occur inside the active update body. Ordered-dot and publication headers remain separately sampled.

interpretation.next_direction: Retain exact source expression operations and their rounding, full affine preflight/private scratch and original replay. For a source-closed scalar F64 expression whose only FP observation is the final cell, prove that finite results need no intermediate classification: a used NaN propagates through every supported arithmetic operation, and unsupported conversions/FP predicates/effects are rejected. Collect final-result nonfinite masks without per-cell control transfers, test once before complete scratch publication, and replay the unchanged DAG for any nonfinite result. Hoist only source-proved inner-coordinate-independent immutable reads within each current row. This materially removes observed per-node/per-cell guard work rather than retrying c946.
interpretation.limits: No gain is claimed. A new candidate needs a committed prospective plan, complete proof/IEEE/error/resource/restoration tests, exact optimization counters, genuine Objects and its single prospective probe. Formal promotion remains optimization-only; accepted58 is restored before that work.
